profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer in Test - Digital Solutions
profile.summary:
I am a clinician with a strong background in emergency care, clinical informatics, quality engineering, and software test engineering. I bring a unique blend of hands‑on clinical experience and technical expertise, allowing me to bridge the gap between healthcare operations and digital solutions.

Skilled in clinical applications, medical devices, and mobile health technologies, I focus on optimizing tools that support care delivery, enhance usability, and improve system performance. My work includes improving the reliability, safety, and usability of healthcare technologies, including medical devices, mobile apps, and cloud‑based applications that support clinicians in fast‑paced environments.

With strong analytical skills and experience working across modern cloud platforms, I’m committed to advancing systems that make care safer, more efficient, and more intuitive for both patients and healthcare teams.

Core competencies:
  
·        Test and System Engineering Leadership  
·        FDA & ISO Regulatory Compliance (21 CFR 820; ISO 13485, 14971; IEC 62304)  
·        Risk Management  
·        Design Controls  
·        Software Requirements Definition  
·        Test Strategy  
·        Team Mentorship  
·        Audit Readiness  
·        Software Testing (Verification and Validation)  
·        Clinical Workflows  
·        Clinical Decision Support  
·        Usability  
·        Agile Delivery
